arxiv-2105-11311.title: Revised Best Estimates for the Age and Mass of the Methuselah Star HD 140283 using MESA and Interferometry and Implications for 1D Convection
arxiv-2105-11311.creator: Jianling Tang(汤健羚), Meridith Joyce
arxiv-2105-11311.description: Abstract In light of recently revised observational measurements of the radius and spectroscopic parameters of the extremely old and metal-poor Gaia benchmark star HD 140283—also known as the Methuselah star due to prior suggestions that its age is in tension with the age of the Universe—we present new, best estimates for the star’s mass and age from stellar modeling.

arxiv-2211-15944.title: The Effectiveness of World Models for Continual Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2211-15944.creator: Samuel Kessler, Mateusz Ostaszewski, Michał Bortkiewicz, Mateusz Żarski, Maciej Wołczyk, Jack Parker-Holder, Stephen J. Roberts, Piotr Miłoś
arxiv-2211-15944.description: Abstract World models power some of the most efficient reinforcement learning algorithms. In this work, we showcase that they can be harnessed for continual learning – a situation when the agent faces changing environments. World models typically employ a replay buffer for training, which can be naturally extended to continual learning.

arxiv-2310-09839.title: Black hole ringdown from physically sensible initial value problem in higher-order scalar-tensor theories Preprint: RUP-23-19, YITP-23-118
arxiv-2310-09839.creator: Keisuke Nakashi, Masashi Kimura, Hayato Motohashi, Kazufumi Takahashi
arxiv-2310-09839.description: Abstract We study odd-parity perturbations about static and spherically symmetric black hole solutions with a linearly time-dependent scalar field in higher-order scalar-tensor theories. In particular, we consider stealth Schwarzschild and stealth Schwarzschild-de Sitter solutions, where the deviation from the general relativity case is controlled by a single parameter.

arxiv-2403-15143.title: Modular Deep Active Learning Framework for Image Annotation: A Technical Report for the Ophthalmo-AI Project
arxiv-2403-15143.creator: Md Abdul Kadir, Hasan Md Tusfiqur Alam, Pascale Maul, Hans-Jürgen Profitlich, Moritz Wolf, Daniel Sonntag
arxiv-2403-15143.description: Abstract Image annotation is one of the most essential tasks for guaranteeing proper treatment for patients and tracking progress over the course of therapy in the field of medical imaging and disease diagnosis. However, manually annotating a lot of 2D and 3D imaging data can be extremely tedious.

arxiv-2408-10356.title: Diversity and stylization of the contemporary user-generated visual arts in the complexity-entropy plane
arxiv-2408-10356.creator: Seunghwan Kim ID, Byunghwee Lee ID, Wonjae Lee ID
arxiv-2408-10356.description: Abstract The advent of computational and numerical methods in recent times has provided new avenues for analyzing art historiographical narratives and tracing the evolution of art styles therein. Here, we investigate an evolutionary process underpinning the emergence and stylization of contemporary user-generated visual art styles using the complexity-entropy ( C - H ) plane, which quantifies local structures in paintings.

arxiv-2412-03050.title: Topology Reconstruction of a Class of Electrical Networks with Limited Boundary Measurements
arxiv-2412-03050.creator: Shivanagouda Biradar & Deepak U Patil
arxiv-2412-03050.description: Abstract We consider the problem of recovering the topology and the edge conductance value, as well as characterizing a set of electrical networks that satisfy the limitedly available Thevenin impedance measurements. The measurements are obtained from an unknown electrical network, which is assumed to belong to a class of circular planar passive electrical network.

arxiv-2501-09747.title: FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models Thanks: ∗ : Core contributors Correspondence to: research@physicalintelligence.company
arxiv-2501-09747.creator: Karl Pertsch, Kyle Stachowicz, Brian Ichter, Danny Driess, Suraj Nair, Quan Vuong, Oier Mees, Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine
arxiv-2501-09747.description: Abstract Autoregressive sequence models, such as Transformer-based vision-language action (VLA) policies, can be tremendously effective for capturing complex and generalizable robotic behaviors. However, such models require us to choose a tokenization of our continuous action signals, which determines how the discrete symbols predicted by the model map to continuous robot actions.

arxiv-2506-10074.title: EFT Corrections to Charged Black Hole Quasinormal Modes
arxiv-2506-10074.creator: William L. Boyce, and Jorge E. Santos
arxiv-2506-10074.description: Abstract We study the impact of higher-derivative corrections from Effective Field Theory on the quasinormal mode spectrum of Reissner–Nordström black holes. While previous work has explored corrections to Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes—typically using small-rotation approximations—a comprehensive analysis near extremality remains lacking.

arxiv-2507-14295.title: A Simple "Try Again" Can Elicit Multi-Turn LLM Reasoning
arxiv-2507-14295.creator: Licheng Liu 1* , Zihan Wang 2* , Linjie Li 3 , Chenwei Xu 2 , Yiping Lu 2 , Han Liu 2 , Avirup Sil 4 , Manling Li 2 1 Imperial College London 2 Northwestern University 3 University of Washington 4 IBM Research AI unary-feedback.github.io
arxiv-2507-14295.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Licheng Liu 1* , Zihan Wang 2* , Linjie Li 3 , Chenwei Xu 2 , Yiping Lu 2 , Han Liu 2 , Avirup Sil 4 , Manling Li 2 1 Imperial College London 2 Northwestern University 3 University of Washington 4 IBM Research AI unary-feedback.github.io. Multi-turn problem solving is critical yet challenging for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to reflect on their reasoning and revise from feedback. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods train large reasoning models on a single-turn paradigm with verifiable rewards.

pmc-11340700.title: Effectiveness of digital Cognitive-Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia in patients with musculoskeletal complaints and insomnia in primary care physiotherapy: study protocol for a randomised controlled trial
pmc-11340700.creator: Eivind Schjelderup Skarpsno, Jonas Grevle Hofmo, Maria Hrozanova, Øystein Vedaa, Astrid Woodhouse, Tormod Landmark, Lennart Bentsen, Jonas Bloch Thorlund, Anne Lovise Nordstoga, Ingebrigt Meisingset
pmc-11340700.description: IntroductionInsomnia is prevalent among patients visiting physiotherapists due to musculoskeletal complaints and associated with poorer pain prognosis. Cognitive-Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) may be effective for improving sleep quality and pain-related outcomes in these patients, but its availability and utility are limited in daily physiotherapy practice.

pmc-11359113.title: Investigation of Extracted Plasma Cell-Free DNA as a Biomarker in Foals with Sepsis
pmc-11359113.creator: Kallie J Hobbs, Bethanie L Cooper, Katarzyna Dembek, M Katie Sheats, Daniel Moura de Aguiar
pmc-11359113.description: Simple SummaryCell-free DNA (cfDNA) are pieces of DNA released from cells into body fluids. Previous studies in adult horses found that plasma cfDNA concentrations differed significantly between healthy horses and those with emergencies like colic. These studies also showed that accurate measurement of plasma cfDNA in adult horses required extraction, due to matrix effects of equine plasma.

pmc-11616458.title: Impact of prior dengue infection on severity and outcomes: meta-analysis of placebo-controlled trials
pmc-11616458.creator: Alejandro Macchia, Silvana Figar, Cristián Biscayart, Fernán González Bernaldo de Quirós
pmc-11616458.description: Objective.This study evaluated the association between serologically confirmed prior dengue infection and the subsequent risk of virologically confirmed dengue, severe dengue, dengue hospitalization, dengue-related death and all-cause mortality.Methods.A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted following PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) guidelines.

pmc-12517958.title: Association between sex steroid hormones and obstructive sleep apnea among US adults: Data from the 2015 to 2016 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
pmc-12517958.creator: Qing Guo, Jiayuan Wang
pmc-12517958.description: This study aimed to explore the association between serum steroid hormones (testosterone, estrogen), sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) levels, and the risk of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) among adults in the United States, as well as to evaluate the potential utility of these biomarkers for OSA risk screening.

pmc-12587308.title: Inter‐Organ Crosstalk and Regulatory Mechanisms of Skeletal Muscle‐Derived Extracellular Vesicles in Systemic Metabolic Homeostasis
pmc-12587308.creator: Zhuoying Wu, Yuanyuan Gao, Qi Chen, Li Yuan
pmc-12587308.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs), including exosomes, play a pivotal role in intercellular communication by facilitating the transfer of bioactive molecules between cells. These vesicles, which encompass a variety of subtypes such as exosomes, microvesicles and apoptotic bodies, carry functional proteins, mRNAs, miRNAs and other molecular cargo that influence various physiological processes.

pmc-12706428.title: Predictors of Ability to Work in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-12706428.creator: Gustaf J Wellhagen, Sebastian Ueckert, Elisabet Nielsen, Carl Smith, Xinyi Li, Joachim Burman, Mats O Karlsson
pmc-12706428.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic disorder that typically shows accumulation of disability, affecting the ability to work. The disease severity is usually graded by physicians with the expanded disability status scale (EDSS) in the clinic, but patient‐reported outcome questionnaires are also available, like the Multiple Sclerosis Impact Scale (MSIS‐29) or Fatigue Scale for Motor and Cognitive Functions (FSMC).

pmc-12717736.title: Diagnostic performance of the blood urea/creatinine ratio in the diagnosis of occult upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage in the ICU
pmc-12717736.creator: Keyvan Meghdadi, Hervé Kpeglo, My Linh Tran Minh, Romain Barthelemy, Benjamin Chousterman, Charles de Roquetaillade
pmc-12717736.description: mucosal defense mechanisms and predisposes to ulceration and UGIH. The incidence of occult UGIH in ICU patients is challenging to determine but has been reported to range from 5% to 30%, with many cases likely remaining undiagnosed [2]. The gold standard for diagnosing UGIH is esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD). However, EGD carries inherent risks and significant human and financial costs.

pmc-13041047.title: The effects of combined aerobic and resistance exercise on older adults with sarcopenia: a meta-analysis
pmc-13041047.creator: Xiaobei Hao, Huigui Hu, Junyu Chen, Qing Wang, Guihua Xu
pmc-13041047.description: ObjectivesThis study investigated the effects of combined aerobic and resistance exercise on muscle strength, physical performance, and body composition in older adults with sarcopenia.MethodsA systematic search was conducted across PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Scopus, The Cochrane Library, CINAHL, and SPORTDiscus for randomized controlled trials on combined exercise interventions for sarcopenia, covering studies up to January 18, 2026.

pmc-13388913.title: Controlled sweat generation via ultrasound stimulation integrated in a wearable device
pmc-13388913.creator: Litong Chen, Benxing Su, Geng Zhong, Jing Wang, Yongxiang Ji, Zhongzeng Zhou, Xuecheng He, Tailin Xu
pmc-13388913.description: Wearable sweat biosensors enable noninvasive molecular monitoring, but reliable and comfortable on-demand sweat induction remains challenging. We developed a soft, skin-conformal wearable device that integrates ultrasound-assisted sweat generation with electrochemical sensing. Low-frequency ultrasound enhanced transdermal delivery of carbachol from a hydrogel reservoir, inducing localized sweat secretion under resting conditions without electrical current or skin penetration.
